scenes.title: Следующий шаг  (The Next Step)
scenes.summary: At the bar in Claude Monet, Nastya approaches Kostya with a sweet proposition: she wants to spend the evening at his apartment to take the next step in their romance. Delighted and flustered, Kostya rushes off to buy candles to make the night special. Listen to their conversation in Russian first, then we will break down each line in English.

scenes.title: Чужая машина  (Someone Else's Car)
scenes.summary: In the parking courtyard behind Claude Monet, Chef Viktor arrives to find an unfamiliar car parked in his favorite spot. When he confronts the driver, she turns out to be Elena, the formidable chef of a rival restaurant, who refuses to budge. Listen to their conversation in Russian first, then we will break down each line in English.

scenes.title: Пешком до работы  (Walking to Work)
scenes.summary: Driving to work together in the morning, Victoria pulls over a block away from Claude Monet and asks Max to walk the rest of the way on foot. Wary of workplace gossip, Victoria insists on keeping their secret relationship under wraps, while Max playfully teases her about ruining his reputation. Listen to their conversation in Russian first, then we will break down each line in English.

scenes.title: Тайный роман  (A Secret Romance)
scenes.summary: As they commute to the restaurant, Victoria suggests they shouldn't arrive together to avoid damaging her professional reputation, though Max mockingly agrees.

scenes.title: Опоздание Макса  (Max's Tardiness)
scenes.summary: Max arrives late to the kitchen, claiming he just overslept. The Chef immediately punishes him with warehouse duty and asks Victoria for her opinion.

scenes.title: Берите сети  (Get the Nets)
scenes.summary: While working his punishment shift in the stockroom, Max accidentally creates a huge mess, prompting the Chef to desperately call for all available nets.

scenes.title: Разбитое зеркало  (A Broken Mirror)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts Elena Pavlovna outside the restaurant and smashes her car's side mirror in retaliation, much to the amusement of the kitchen staff.

scenes.title: Признание Насти  (Nastya's Confession)
scenes.summary: Nastya confesses to Kostya that she was the one who broke the Chef's mirror, but Kostya is only interested in whether their date is still on.

scenes.title: Ссора перед отъездом  (An Argument Before Leaving)
scenes.summary: Max confronts Vika about her trip to Milan, begging to explain himself. The next morning, Vika reveals she missed her flight because of him.

scenes.title: Звонок из Милана  (A Call from Milan)
scenes.summary: Max makes a fake call to the restaurant to cancel Vika's trip.

scenes.title: Мусорные баки  (The Trash Bins)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov and Elena argue about the trash bins and Timur the supplier.

scenes.title: Признание  (The Confession)
scenes.summary: Kostya offers to take the blame for the broken mirror, but Nastya confesses.

scenes.title: Признание перед шефом  (Confession Before the Chef)
scenes.summary: Feeling guilty over Chef Barinov's damaged car mirror, Kostya tries to take the blame himself to protect Nastya. However, Nastya rushes forward to confess that she accidentally hit the mirror while riding her bicycle, leading to a surprisingly peaceful resolution. Let's listen to their confession in Russian.

scenes.title: Честный разговор  (An Honest Conversation)
scenes.summary: Visiting Nastya at her apartment, Kostya expects a romantic evening together. However, Nastya candidly confesses that she feels uncomfortable acting out of obligation or gratitude rather than genuine love, leading to a tender and respectful agreement. Let's listen to their conversation in Russian.

scenes.title: Разговор на складе  (Talk in the Stockroom)
scenes.summary: Victoria enters the restaurant storeroom only to find Max sitting comfortably among the crates instead of working. As Victoria tries to lecture him about maturity and the impropriety of their workplace relationship, Max counters her worries with charming romance. Let's listen to their flirtatious conversation in Russian.

scenes.title: Утро после клуба  (The Morning After the Club)
scenes.summary: Victoria wakes up in Max's bed horrified, but Max playfully reminds her of her desperate late-night phone call begging for a rescue.

scenes.title: Неловкая встреча  (An Awkward Encounter)
scenes.summary: In the apartment hallway, Nastya unexpectedly bumps into Victoria leaving Max's room, leading to an awkward conversation about work and secrecy.

scenes.title: Тайны персонала  (Staff Secrets)
scenes.summary: Victoria returns to Max's room furious that Nastya saw her, accusing him of ruining her reputation before they leave for work.

scenes.title: Угнанная машина  (The Stolen Car)
scenes.summary: Elena discovers her car is missing and threatens Barinov, who then forces a confession from Fedya.

scenes.title: Разоблачение  (The Exposure)
scenes.summary: Nagiev confronts Vika about her fake excuse and forces her to pay for the trip herself.

scenes.title: Разбитая машина  (The Crashed Car)
scenes.summary: Elena assesses the damage to her car while Barinov tries to prevent her from filing a police report.

scenes.title: Границы  (Borders)
scenes.summary: Vika angrily breaks up with Max, while the narrator reflects on the walls people build between themselves.
